moments.title: August Bank Holiday Weekend
moments.blurb: The last long weekend of summer for most of the UK is coming up, with the August Bank Holiday falling on Monday, August 31st, 2026.

angles.name: Summer's Last Hurrah
angles.copy: Who's making the most of the August Bank Holiday weekend? Last chance for a summer getaway or a big BBQ before autumn officially arrives!

angles.name: Long Weekend Vibes
angles.copy: That August Bank Holiday feeling is just around the corner! What are your plans for the long weekend, or are you just planning to relax?

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival 2026
moments.blurb: The Reading & Leeds Festivals run from August 27-30, 2026, with headliners including Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, Fontaines D.C., Chase & Status Live, and Raye.

angles.name: Festival Fever
angles.copy: Who's ready to hit the fields this weekend? Reading & Leeds is ON with Florence + The Machine, Charli XCX, Dave and more taking the stage!

angles.name: Headliner Hype
angles.copy: From indie anthems to grime heavyweights, Reading & Leeds has it all this weekend. Which headliner are you most excited to see?

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing 2026 Launch
moments.blurb: Strictly Come Dancing is set to return with its pre-recorded launch show airing on Saturday, September 19, 2026, introducing new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe and Johannes Radebe.

angles.name: Strictly's Back
angles.copy: Dust off your dancing shoes! Strictly Come Dancing returns September 19th with a brand new hosting trio. Who's ready for the glitterball magic?

angles.name: New Hosts Alert
angles.copy: Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe and Johannes Radebe are taking the Strictly reins! Excited to see the new dynamic when the launch show airs on September 19th?
